title: Network Participation Agreements — Recredentialing Due Date and the Plan Down Payment
content:
**Rule.** When a practice under the **Network Participation Agreements** places an agreement's open overpayments in a repayment plan, an approaching recredentialing due date on that agreement raises the down payment. The down payment credentialing points are set by the whole months from today to the agreement's recredentialing due date:

- fewer than 6 months adds 10 percentage points to the down payment percentage;
- 6 months or more but fewer than 12 adds 5 percentage points;
- 12 months or more adds nothing.

The down payment percentage is the percentage at which the down payment base is taken.

## Counting whole months

- The recredentialing due date is the date shown on the agreement record.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from today to that date, less one when the due date's day of the month is smaller than today's day of the month.
- A due date that has already passed gives fewer than 6 months.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Today | Recredentialing due date | Whole months | Points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 10 September same year | 6 | 5 |
| 10 March | 9 September same year | 5 | 10 |
| 10 March | 10 March next year | 12 | Nothing |
| 10 March | 9 March next year | 11 | 5 |
